                cc=[]; q=collections.deque([(y,x)])
                while True:

                    seen.add((cy,cx)); cc.append((cy,cx))

def solve(g):
    A=np.array(g); H,W=len(A),len(A[0]); cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); comp=[]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            if A[y,x]!=bg and (y,x) not in seen:
                stack=[(y,x)]; cc=[]
                while stack:
                    cy,cx=stack.pop()
                    if (cy,cx) in seen or A[cy,cx]==bg: continue
                    seen.add((cy,cx)); cc.append((cy,cx))
                    for dy,dx in [(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)]:
                        ny,nx=cy+dy,cx+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and (ny,nx) not in seen and A[ny,nx]!=bg:
                            stack.append((ny,nx))
                comp.append(cc)
    csorted=sorted(comp,key=lambda c:-len(c))
    big=csorted[-1]; markers=csorted[:-1]
    rs=[p[0] for p in big]; csrs=[p[1] for p in big]
    minr,minc=min(rs),min(csrs); maxr,maxc=max(rs),max(csrs)
    th=h=max(maxr-minr+1,maxc-minc+1); wv=w=maxc-minc+1
    T=[[A[r][c] for c in range(minc,minc+wv)] for r in range(minr,minr+th)]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for ry,mx in markers:
        ty,tx=ry-th//2,mx-wv//2
        for i in range(th):
            for j in range(wv):
                ny,nx=ty+i,tx+j
                if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W: out[ny][nx]=T[i][j]
    return [row.tolist() for row in out]
